questions.q: Statement I Alkali metals dissolve in liquid ammonia to give blue solutions. Statement II Alkali metals in liquid ammonia give solvated species of the type $\left(M\left(\mathrm{NH}_3\right)_n\right]^{+}(M=$ alkali metals $)$.
options:
Statement I is true, Statement II is true, Statement II is a correct explanation for Statement I

Statement I is true, Statement II is true, Statement II is not a correct explanation for Statement I

Statement I is true, Statement II is false

Statement $\mathrm{I}$ is false, Statement $\mathrm{II}$ is true
questions.solution: Alkali metals in ammonia gives blue colour due to ammoniated $e^{-}$
